name: Schnapsbrennerei Kitzbühel
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The prestigious **Edelbrennerei Kitzbühel** invites you to an exclusive tour with tastings. Discover the art of distilling—from fruit selection and mash preparation to aging in oak barrels. Enjoy samples of award-winning fruit brandies, liqueurs, and premium spirits, all crafted with tradition and expertise.
